scope: Exact 0/90/180/270-degree offline Play2Code quarter-turn derivation and isolated native Minecraft qualification of the frozen H04/v16 construction sequence

semantics.positive_direction: Positive rotation follows positive Minecraft yaw: clockwise on a north-up map viewed from above.
semantics.rotation_anchor_meaning: The explicit anchor is the local construction-origin voxel; continuous feet, pose, view-target and hit points rotate about that voxel's centre.
semantics.operation_order: mirror, then quarter-turn rotation, then integer translation
semantics.yaw: Pure rotation adds the selected quarter turn and normalizes to [-180,180). Pitch is unchanged.
semantics.faces: Horizontal support-face vectors rotate exactly; up and down remain unchanged.
semantics.recorded_directions: Pure rotation retains player-local forward/back/left/right labels because yaw rotates with the path. Reflection still exchanges lateral labels.
semantics.s1: The recorded point and voxel homes are not transformed. The generated sequence retains exactly one first-batch S1 relative and no continuation re-homing.
semantics.floating_point_policy: Quarter turns use exact coordinate swaps and sign changes rather than trigonometric coordinate rotation.

transformed_fields: M0 movement points, recorded yaw and recorded direction
M3 recorded path points and yaw
M4 movement points, support voxels, faces, poses, hit positions and yaw
M5 edge and landing points plus yaw
I3 support voxels, placement faces, recorded pose and recorded aim

native_functionality.criterion: At least one fresh, immutable, independently verified strict GO exists for each required orientation.
native_functionality.acceptance: Each selected GO has exact 71-block geometry, zero missing/incorrect/unexpected cells, a clear rotated entrance, complete roof, accessible interior, safe player, native read-only verification and matching post-exit closed-save verification.

retained_failure.reason: M4 recorded_path_sample_not_reached at sample 22; the final observed distance was just outside the unchanged 0.3 radius.
retained_failure.classification: The independently calculated coordinates, yaw, faces and support dependencies matched. No tolerance or retry was added. Fresh ROT180-B passed the unchanged frozen program.

repeatability.note: Functionality and repeatability remain separate. ROT180-A is not discarded or relabelled.

automated_regression.tls_interop: PASS, 10/10 checks including TLS 1.2/1.3, pinned certificate and hostname verification, API-key enforcement and plaintext rejection

limitations: Direction-sensitive Minecraft block-state rotation is not qualified; the benchmark uses cobblestone.
The result qualifies the frozen H04 construction strategy on the isolated equivalent Superflat fixture, not arbitrary structures or terrain.
Derived exports are not new human recordings and do not replace any H01-H05 or R/X historical verdict.

subsequent_stabilization.historical_scope_preserved: All fields above remain the immutable QROT01 point-in-time result; ROT180-A remains NO_GO.
subsequent_stabilization.new_full_native_regression: GO, 10/10 including identity, X01 and X03

privacy: Raw timelines, absolute captured homes, player identity, actor tokens, worlds, journals, credentials, certificates and private keys remain outside this public-safe evidence file.
